the client refuses a flat 'mcp__server__tool' call name with 'unsupported call'; the accepted shape is a namespace function_call {namespace:'mcp__<server>', name:'<tool>'}.
an outer jsonrpc member is tolerated when it is '2.0' and rejected otherwise; this build's own envelopes carry none.
the client flattened MCP tools into one namespace tool per server, so the tool list is not one function per MCP tool.
